title: The First Two People on Top of Everest
description: 29 May 1953: Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary reach the summit.

scenes.narration: No human had ever stood here. Until this morning.
scenes.image_prompt: summit ridge of Mount Everest with snow plume, two tiny climbers, deep blue sky

scenes.narration: It's May 29th, 1953. Tenzing Norgay and Edmund Hillary are close to the top of Mount Everest.
scenes.image_prompt: two 1950s mountaineers with oxygen tanks climbing a snowy ridge high in the Himalaya

scenes.narration: They've spent the night in a tiny tent at about 8,500 metres.
scenes.image_prompt: small tent on a steep snowy ledge at night high on a mountain, stars

scenes.narration: Hillary's boots froze overnight. He warms them over a stove.
scenes.image_prompt: 1950s climber thawing frozen boots over a small stove inside a tent

scenes.narration: A steep rock step blocks the ridge. Hillary squeezes up a crack beside it.
scenes.image_prompt: climber wedged in a crack between rock and ice on a narrow summit ridge

scenes.narration: At 11:30 in the morning, they reach the summit.
scenes.image_prompt: two mountaineers standing on the summit of Everest, flags, endless peaks below

scenes.narration: They spend about fifteen minutes on top. Tenzing leaves offerings in the snow.
scenes.image_prompt: Sherpa climber placing small offerings in the snow on a summit

scenes.narration: Everest is 8,849 metres tall. Would you ever try to climb it? Comment below.
scenes.image_prompt: Mount Everest at sunset glowing orange above clouds
